coverage.text: Fall 2026 Final (Fri 12/18, 11:30am–2:30pm, 75 points, paper). The course pages don’t state its scope; this option assumes the whole course, including Gleam (which replaced Scheme this semester).

advice: Recommended problems (★ and ◆) are everything course staff recommended for Midterms 1–3; each says which exam it was picked for. As of 10/29/2026, staff haven’t named final practice problems. A TA said to assume everything through the end of the course may be on the final, with detailed scope posted about a week before the exam.

scope.note: Problems are included when every topic tagged on them is on the course’s in-scope topic list, plus Gleam, which replaced Scheme this semester and is on the final. Scheme questions stay out of scope. That classification is this site’s, not a staff recommendation; the Gleam topic tags are this site’s too until the course staff publish theirs.

timed.intro: Each exam draws past exam and site-authored practice problems from the whole course at random and balances them across topics: early material, recursion and lists, trees/objects/iterators/efficiency, SQL, and Gleam and interpreters (including site-authored exercises, labeled as such). The 50-minute exam draws 3 problems from different topic groups. No more than one problem comes from the same source exam when there’s a choice. Past-exam problems aren’t modified, so you may have seen some of them.
